problem.title: Lexicographically Smallest Permutation Greater Than Target

approaches.title: Greedy multiset matching with backtracking
approaches.summary: Builds a character-frequency bucket, matches the target greedily, and backtracks to the rightmost position that can be increased when necessary. It then appends the remaining characters in sorted order to obtain the smallest valid greater permutation.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial greedy permutation algorithm using a frequency bucket, next-greater character search, and backtracking.
Refactors the same algorithm into more idiomatic Rust with a `for` loop, direct byte indexing, preallocated output capacity, and simplified UTF-8 conversion.
